Dear Mio Yumesaki ⛄️
Nice to meet you! My name is Amano (Sorano) Lydia, a lonely gamer angel Vtuber. I am a lonely gamer angel Vtuber, and I am Lydia Amano (Sorano).

I would like to ask you for an illustration that I can use in my activities, so I would like to send you a request!
I would like to use your illustration for my activities.
For use in X (Oha V images, etc.)
For use in Fanbox (for use in the distribution of returned goods, etc.)
Thumbnails for distribution sites

Composition
We would be happy if only the costume could be a white bunny.
We would appreciate it if you could also include your own motifs such as baby bottles, angel's wings, and angel's rings in the accessories.
The pose is basically up to the artist.
 We would appreciate it if you could draw her as close to her body as possible, so that the angel rings, wings, hair, etc. do not show through.

We have saved the materials to Google Drive, so please refer to that for reference!
We would appreciate it if you could provide us with the transparent image of the person and the background separately as a png file.
Thank you for your cooperation. 🙇🏻‍♀️´-
